title: Module 8: Present Tense and Past Tense

questions.question: He ___ coffee.
questions.trap: Dua kesalahan umum: 'don't' untuk subjek tunggal dan -s pada verb setelah does.
questions.explanation: Setelah does/doesn't, verb kembali ke base form: doesn't drink.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.trap: 'is boiling' terdengar seperti proses yang sedang terjadi.
questions.explanation: Fakta ilmiah/kebenaran umum memakai present simple (boils).

questions.question: Right now, I ___ a report.
questions.trap: Present simple 'write' terasa netral.
questions.explanation: 'Right now' = sedang berlangsung = present continuous (am writing).

questions.question: Yesterday I ___ the file.
questions.trap: 'have deleted' mengikuti pola bahasa Indonesia 'sudah menghapus'.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' = waktu selesai = past simple (deleted), bukan present perfect.

questions.question: He ___ to Bali in 2022.
questions.trap: 'has gone' terdengar wajar untuk pengalaman perjalanan.
questions.explanation: Tahun spesifik di masa lalu = past simple (went).

questions.question: What is the past of 'write'?
questions.trap: 'written' juga bentuk dari 'write'.
questions.explanation: Past simple = wrote; past participle = written (dipakai dengan have/has/had).

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'break'?
questions.trap: 'broke' lebih sering terdengar.
questions.explanation: Past simple = broke; past participle (V3) = broken, dipakai dengan have/has/had.

questions.question: ___ you finish the report yesterday?
questions.trap: 'Have' terdengar natural dalam pertanyaan.
questions.explanation: 'yesterday' memerlukan past simple, jadi pertanyaan memakai Did + base form.

questions.question: What is the 3rd person singular of 'study'?
questions.trap: Aturan -y mudah terbalik.
questions.explanation: Konsonan + y berubah menjadi -ies (study -> studies); vokal + y cukup -s (play -> plays).

questions.question: What is the past of 'stop'?
questions.trap: Ejaan sederhana tapi sering salah.
questions.explanation: Pola CVC (konsonan-vokal-konsonan) pada suku kata tekan menggandakan konsonan akhir: stopped.

questions.question: I ___ this laptop since 2024.
questions.trap: 'since' menggoda present simple.
questions.explanation: Present perfect dengan since.

questions.question: She ___ here for three years.
questions.trap: 'for' dikira penanda past simple.
questions.explanation: Aksi dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung = present perfect (has worked).

questions.question: They ___ already finished.
questions.trap: 'already' bisa dipakai dengan past simple, jadi 'did' menggoda.
questions.explanation: Present perfect = have/has + V3. 'They' = have.

questions.question: While I ___ the code, the power went out.
questions.trap: Dua kejadian lampau mudah ditulis past simple semua.
questions.explanation: Aksi panjang yang terganggu aksi pendek = past continuous (was testing).

questions.question: I ___ for two hours when she called.
questions.trap: 'have been waiting' terdengar natural di percakapan.
questions.explanation: Aksi panjang yang sudah berlangsung sebelum titik lampau ('when she called') = past perfect continuous (had been waiting).

questions.question: She moved to Surabaya two years ___.
questions.trap: 'before', 'since', 'for' semuanya kata waktu.
questions.explanation: 'ago' dipakai setelah durasi untuk menghitung mundur dari sekarang, dengan past simple.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.trap: 'have seen' + yesterday terasa wajar bagi penutur Indonesia ('sudah melihat kemarin').
questions.explanation: Waktu spesifik yang sudah selesai (yesterday) = past simple, bukan present perfect.

questions.question: She ___ TV when the phone rang.
questions.trap: Dua aksi lampau mudah ditulis past simple semua.
questions.explanation: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung lalu terpotong = past continuous (was watching).

questions.question: We ___ play badminton every Sunday when we were kids.
questions.trap: 'use to' tanpa -d sering ditulis.
questions.explanation: Kebiasaan masa lalu yang sudah berhenti = used to + base form.

questions.question: I ___ him since last week.
questions.trap: 'didn't see' terdengar natural karena 'last week'.
questions.explanation: 'since' menuntut present perfect: haven't + V3.

questions.question: Which time expression goes with present perfect?
questions.trap: Semua opsi adalah keterangan waktu, tapi hanya satu yang terhubung ke sekarang.
questions.explanation: 'so far' = sampai saat ini, pasangan present perfect. yesterday, last night, in 2020 = waktu selesai, pasangan past simple.

questions.question: Which time expression goes with simple past?
questions.trap: 'up to now' dan 'yet' terdengar seperti keterangan waktu biasa.
questions.explanation: 'last night' = titik waktu yang sudah selesai. 'so far', 'yet', 'up to now' mengarah ke sekarang.

questions.question: Which sentence implies the keys are STILL missing now?

options.A: I lost my keys last week.
options.D: I used to lose my keys.

questions.trap: Past simple juga menyebut kehilangan.
questions.explanation: Present perfect menekankan hasil yang masih terasa sekarang. 'last week' menutup kejadian di masa lalu.

questions.question: He ___ at 9 pm last night.
questions.trap: 'works' atau 'has worked' mengabaikan penanda waktu lampau.
questions.explanation: Titik waktu spesifik di masa lalu saat aksi berlangsung = past continuous (was working).

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?

options.C: He has been working here since 2020.

questions.trap: 'is working ... since' terdengar benar karena memakai continuous.
questions.explanation: Aksi dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut: has/have been + V-ing, dengan since + titik awal.
